correctStatements.text: At 09:00 bo reported uploads hanging at ninety percent for many users.
At 09:06 ada found the antivirus scanner step never returned for images over 8 MB.
At 09:20 cy deployed the scanner rollback.
At 09:28 bo saw uploads finish normally again.
At 09:35 ada saw the stuck uploads from the last hour retried by the queue.
The newer scanner version had a bug with large files and auto updates were on.
At 09:31 cy saw the queue depth for the scanner back to zero.
Bo will turn off auto updates for the scanner and review versions by hand.
Cy will add a timeout so a hanging scan fails the upload clearly.
A buggy scanner update hung large image uploads until the rollback.
